component.name: Badge
component.description: Static category label pill. Outline: border only, transparent background. Filled: neutral-subtlest background. Purely presentational — no selection state and no interaction semantics. Distinct from Chip, which is an interactive selection toggle.

useWhen: Labelling a course or card with a static category (e.g. Design, Development)
Showing a non-interactive level or status (e.g. Beginner, New, Certified)
Displaying a compact metadata token in a card or list row

notFor.case: Using Badge as a filter the user can toggle
notFor.because: Badge is display-only with no selection state or click semantics.
notFor.note: Use Chip, which renders a button with aria-pressed for selection.

notFor.case: Using Badge as a clickable action
notFor.because: Badge renders a <span> and carries no action weight.

notFor.case: Putting long sentences inside a Badge
notFor.because: Badge is a compact pill with nowrap text; long content breaks the layout.

useWhen.outline: Bordered pill on transparent background. Use on plain surfaces where a fill would compete with surrounding content.
useWhen.filled: Neutral-subtlest background, no visible border. Use on elevated or busy surfaces where a fill reads more clearly than a thin border.
